name: Lumotaxia
source:
You've grown up with the folktales all your life, but now the time has come to uncover the truth regarding what really lurks out there in the woods...

[From [url=https://toad-wart-studios.itch.io/lumotaxia]Itch.io[/url]]

你从小听着那些民间传说长大，而如今时机已至——是时候揭开密林深处究竟潜伏着何种存在的真相了……

[摘自[url=https://toad-wart-studios.itch.io/lumotaxia]itch.io[/url]]
